text: OWNER DECISION 2026-10-01 (in chat): close the pilot reproducibility channel with a COMMIT-REVEAL custodian secret. root = SHA256(v0 hash || beacon A || secret). Only H(secret) is committed in v0. The custodian generates the secret in-process; it is encrypted to the owner key and revealed at unseal. Combined with per-unit encryption at write (no plaintext raw outputs, ledger or GLMsingle staging left on disk; whitelist computed in-process) and a no-author-agents-during-run rule with a hashed process audit. (S9 review 77b49dc4: F1/F1b, F2.)
